verdict.rationale: Sandbox is fundamentally API/SDK/CLI-driven (SDKs are 'the recommended way to integrate,' CLI supports manual and agentic workflows) and there's a confirmed OpenAPI spec, with the Dashboard shown only as a secondary way to stop sandboxes — suggesting core functionality is API-first. However, there's no explicit documentation confirming full UI/API parity across all dashboard features (e.g., observability views, tags, spend management alerts) are all API-accessible. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement or API reference confirming every dashboard action (stop, observability, spend management) is also exposed via SDK/API, and independent confirmation beyond docs.
